description: Score an entire counterparty portfolio in one call (up to 200 entities by LEI or name). Returns portfolio-level composite E/S/G scores, tier distribution, aggregate fee surcharge impact in basis points, worst offenders (bottom 10% by composite), top performers, MiCA Article 72 ongoing monitoring status, and SFDR PAI flags. The canonical pre-settlement compliance check for treasury systems and TMS integrations.

label.description: Optional label for this portfolio (e.g. "Q3 2026 Counterparties").

leis.description: LEIs to score (fastest — no name resolution).

name: esg.portfolio
